name: IKHCO | Madd Fruit | Live Rosin | 1g
description:
Cross Strains: Papayaberry Runtz x Moroccan Peaches

Maddfruit Live Rosin is a terp-driven powerhouse, bursting with bold tropical fruit, citrus candy, and a subtle funky finish that lingers on the palate. Crafted entirely solventless and pressed from fresh-frozen flower, this extract captures the potency of the plant - delivering a smooth, full-bodied smoke with long-lasting, euphoric effects.

Cross Strains: Papayaberry Runtz x Moroccan Peaches

Maddfruit Live Rosin is a terp-driven powerhouse, bursting with bold tropical fruit, citrus candy, and a subtle funky finish that lingers on the palate.
